'''Corondexx''', or '''Corondex''', was an arms and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] manufacturing corporation. They produced the [[Corondexx Blast Vest]] and the [[VES-700 pulse rifle/Legends|VES-700 Pulse Rifle]].
